title: Phoenix Ghost Tour: Haunted Jails, Rails & Grave Tales
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Safety Note: This is a relaxed-paced walking tour with frequent stops. Guests should be comfortable walking and standing for short periods. By purchasing a ticket and attending, guests acknowledge the normal risks of a walking tour and agree to release Get Ghosted Phoenix LLC from liability for trips, falls, or injuries.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the darker side of downtown Phoenix on this outdoor walking tour through historic jails, railways, courthouses, and forgotten corners of the Warehouse District.

This tour blends real Phoenix history, eerie local true crime stories, and hands-on ghost hunting at select outdoor locations using tools like EMF detectors, dowsing rods, and spirit boxes.

 Are you ready to experience the eerie vibes for yourself?
